name: Черёмушки
summary: The heroes of the series are residents of the Moscow microdistrict of Cheryomushki, whose personal events are connected with the main events of the capital.

name: Indomptables
summary: Indomptables is a sweeping family saga with country influences, telling the story of two clans: the highly influential Richer family, owners of Richer Enterprises, led by Philippe, a man admired by all; and the formidable Martineau family, agricultural producers, disliked in the community and led by the gruff Michel. The two patriarchs are about to finalise a major transaction: Richer Enterprises will pass into the hands of the Martineaus. But this long-awaited agreement will be disrupted by a disturbing and unexpected event. From then on, everything is turned upside down for them, as well as for their three respective heirs, who soon find themselves caught in the crossfire of the merciless struggle that this event ignites between the two families. A war without rules or morals will have consequences that no one could have imagined…

name: Gomorra - Le Origini
summary: The series Gomorra - Le Origini explores Pietro Savastano's youth in the 1970s, in a Naples undergoing a transformation, poverty-stricken and plagued by cigarette smuggling. The story begins in 1977 with a very young Pietro, the son of no one, growing up as an adoptive brother in a family in the poorest part of Secondigliano. A street kid, he scrapes by as best he can, dreaming of a well-being that is still denied him. The story unfolds through Pietro's loss of innocence, along with his brothers and lifelong friends, their ambitions, and his first great love, which, like that of every teenager, will be wild and passionate. His encounter with Angelo, known as 'A Sirena,' the regent of Secondigliano, marks his entry into the world of crime. Through violence, alliances, and betrayals, Pietro discovers the price that life takes.

name: Типы с Казани
summary:
Types from Kazan is a two-part documentary film featuring live performances by popular Kazan comedians.
In the film, we will talk about the development of the stand-up movement in Tatarstan and the Kazan StandUp club, how it all started and how things are now.

name: Recipe for Love
summary:
Both family members of Western and Traditional Korean medicine hospitals in Onjeong City have had bad blood towards each other for 30 years due to a misunderstanding. Ju-ah and Hyun-bin, each hailing from rival medical families, spend a drunken night together. They later find themselves reunited in the workplace as boss and employee.
Even Ju-ah, who is repulsed by the idea of marriage, eventually falls for Hyun-bin, the guy who liked her and who becomes to the ‘straightforward young man', but their relationship turns things upside down for the families. Eventually, the truth of the ‘runaway incident' from 30 years ago is revealed and the two families barely go into reconciliation mode, and it looked like the grudge might end… but a new crisis awaits them.

name: Munmu
summary: A large-scale historical drama that highlights the great victory of the small nation of Silla, which defeated Goguryeo, Baekje, and even the Tang Dynasty, and completed the unification of the three kingdoms.

name: Honour
summary: Ra Young, Shin Jae, and Hyun Jin are lawyers at LnJ, a law firm for women who are victims of sexual abuse. Their relationship is well-defined, starting with Shin Jae's leadership as CEO of the firm. Ra Young serves as a messenger, regarded as a celebrity lawyer with outstanding eloquence, while Hyun Jin always rushes to the scene to find out evidence. They start to investigate a sexual abuse case involving underage students, and they confront the challenging situation head-on against the cartel of sexual abuse on digital platforms. As they approach the truth of the case, their lives begin to fall into danger, while their past memories haunt them repeatedly. Will they be able to save the victims and overcome the bruises from their past? It is the perfect time to retrieve their lost honour.

name: Our Universe
summary: A pair of in-laws, whose constant quarrels have turned affection into animosity, suddenly find themselves responsible for raising their 20-month-old nephew after the unexpected accident of his parents. What follows is a chaotic yet heartwarming romance under one roof.

name: Lorraine Kelly's Norwegian Odyssey
summary: Lorraine Kelly traverses Norway's epic fjords, via majestic mountains and dramatic volcanic islands, embracing the local culture, food and traditions of her northern neighbours along the way.

name: Monty Don's Rhineland Gardens
summary: From the Alps to the North Sea, flowing through big cities, dramatic landscapes and romantic valleys - Monty explores extraordinary gardens shaped by the mighty River Rhine.

name: Taskmasterclass
summary: It's the weirdest and most wonderful competition on television. But is there method behind Taskmaster's madness? Greg Davies and Little Alex Horne reveal all, with the help of some willing victims.

name: David Baddiel: Cat Man
summary: David Baddiel hosts the purr-fect combo of kitty cuteness, cat calamity and feline fun, featuring pawesome viral sensations and some famous cat-loving faces.

name: Aşk Yarası
summary: When Pars discovers his biological father is alive, he is thrust into a new world as the heir of the Akabey family. Leaving behind his impoverished life in Adana, he enters a life of wealth in Istanbul, where he must navigate acceptance from his new family. To end a longstanding feud, he marries Asya, a woman he has never met, despite the lingering memory of Gül, who abandoned him due to his poverty. While Asya loves him unconditionally, Pars is torn between his past and present. As their love is tested, both must confront old wounds, proving that love can heal but also expose the deepest scars.

name: The Road to Glory
summary: In the winter of the fourth year of Shaojing, Xiao Li rescues Wen Yu, a princess of a fallen kingdom. Love blossoms between them, and he risks everything to help her reclaim her throne. Together, they defeat the traitor Pei Song, and Xiao Li rises from a street rogue to become the King of Wei. But at the height of power, their love is put to the test…

name: Stone Age
summary: A modern day comedy set in prehistoric times. Welcome to Rockville, your average, happy and healthy suburban town... with dinosaurs! Follow T-Bone Rex, Stella Stone Age, Neddy Neanderthal, Billy Brontosaurus, Cammy Bedrock, and Little Rock Rex, a group of nine-year-olds who live regular lives, just like you and I... except millions of years ago.

name: Pacto de Sangre
summary: The lives of four lifelong friends take a dramatic turn following an accidental homicide during a bachelor party. Despite their differences, Benjamin, Marcos, Raymond, and Gabriel have sustained their friendship over many years. Their partners, Trinidad, Josefa, and Maite, significant women in their lives, are also part of this group with decades of shared history. However, the tragic death of a dancer at Raymond's bachelor party will forever alter their destinies, forcing them to navigate the turbulent waters of guilt and the fear of losing the lives they've carefully built.

name: Real Life 101
summary: Have you ever wondered what you might want to do for the rest of your life? Have you thought about your "dream job?" Do you have any idea what it takes to get there? Are you headed in the right direction? Real Life 101 introduces you to real people doing real jobs. From doctors, lawyers and veterinarians to fashion designers, sports trainers, music therapists, to college and professional coaches.

name: La Familia del Barrio
summary: The series chronicles the misadventures of a dysfunctional Mexican family consisting of Gaspar, Grandpa, the Norwegian, and Jonathan in a multi-family building called PINO in Mexico City.

name: Kurosaki san no Ichizuna Ai ga Tomaranai
Love Thy Neighbour
summary: Love Thy Neighbour follows Eddie Booth after he leaves England and moves to Australia, continuing his story from the original British series of the same name. Arriving on his own while his wife and child remain back home, Eddie struggles to find his place in a new country, clashing with his Australian neighbours and workmates as his blunt opinions and short fuse collide with local attitudes and customs.

name: MrBeast: Extreme Survival!
summary: In this season, MrBeast pushes contestants and himself into the toughest survival experiments imaginable, from one hundred days in bunkers and circles to freezing expeditions and isolation tests. Every scenario is designed to strip life to its basics and reveal who has the strength, patience, and ingenuity to endure.

name: Agent Kim Reactivated
summary: When an unassuming dad's daughter goes missing, he dusts off his old black-ops skills to track her down — only to attract the wrong kind of attention.

name: Yummy Mummy
summary: Yummy Mummy is a totally unique and ultra hip half-hour weekly parenting series. Set in an interactive virtual environment, it's unlike anything you've ever seen. Hosted by the real deal, yummy mummy Erica Ehm and her eclectic mix of experts, celebrities and yummy mummy guests will celebrate and commiserate the joys and challenges, payoffs and perils of being a modern day parent.

name: Here! Family
summary: Here Family offers a realistic view of raising children within the LGBT community. Covering topics such as non-traditional breastfeeding, surrogates, invitro or adoption, and domestic partnership, the series explores the art of balancing a family with our hectic lives. Also included are celebrity interviews and money-saving tips.

name: A Queen Reborn
summary: Top actress reborn as a general's daughter, allies with a prince to outwit foes and unveil a bloody conspiracy.

name: Rack 'n' Roll Delivery
summary: A snooker prodigy turned delivery driver. A deadly bet. A decade-old murder waiting to be avenged. Once unbeatable, Cheng Ye lost everything when his girlfriend was killed during a rigged match. Now going by "Black Eight," he drifts through the city delivering food until a chance encounter drags him back into the game. The truth behind her death was never what it seemed. To uncover it, he must pick up his cue again. But the man who destroyed his life is watching, and every step toward justice brings him closer to the edge...

name: Sharp Blade in the Snow
summary: A sinister chant of witchcraft rings in her ears like a demon's whisper. As warm blood runs across her palm, Feng Li opens her eyes to find her dagger buried deep in her father's heart. Watching him collapse, she lets out a scream of utter despair. The moment her mother orders her imprisoned in the Cold Palace, Feng Li knows her life has ended on her fifteenth birthday. When she sees daylight again, she is no longer a fallen princess but the newly enthroned empress—her name steeped in infamy, reviled by all. She cares little for the scorn, indulging in pleasure and excess, her smile seductive and unrestrained. During the imperial consort selection, Feng Li's gaze locks onto Yun Moxiao at first sight—she senses a kindred soul. Tracing the scar on his shoulder, she asks with a teasing smile, "They say I murdered my father and brought ruin upon my mother. Aren't you afraid of me?" He whispers at her lips, "If it pleases Your Majesty, my life is yours to take at any time." Their eyes meet—one glance, a lifetime. Old lovers reunite, yet everything has changed. Who would recognize them now as the princess of Wutong Kingdom and the heir of Fusang, once bound beneath the wutong tree by a vow of marriage and happiness? Now, she hides behind a carefully crafted facade, swearing to tear open a rift in this dark and corrupted world. He, having lain dormant for years in a death prison, carries the hatred of a fallen kingdom and has returned with a single purpose: to take her life. Inside and beyond the palace walls, danger lurks in every whisper, conspiracies breeding like ghosts. A lethal entanglement of love and assassination is about to erupt.

name: Happy Tree Friends
summary: The Happy Tree Friends are cute, cuddly animals whose daily adventures always end up going horribly, gruesomely, fatally wrong. No matter how innocently their day begins, it always ends in carnage. The ensemble cast includes Cuddles, the cutest darn rabbit you'll ever meet, Petunia, a sweet girl skunk always mindful to wear air freshener and deranged Flippy the squirrel, who will touch your heart and leave no survivors. Traveling through picturesque settings and speaking in a kooky language all their own, the Happy Tree Friends never know what chaos lingers just around the bend. Happy Tree Friends is not recommended for small children or big babies.

name: Star Detective Precure
summary: Anna Akechi is a 14-year-old second-year middle school student living in Makoto Mirai Town. On her birthday, guided by the fairy Pochitan and a pendant she finds in her room, she time-slips from 2027 to Makoto Mirai City in 1999. There, she meets Mikuru Kobayashi, a 14-year-old girl who dreams of becoming a detective. Suddenly, a robbery incident occurs, as someone has something precious to them stolen. Figuring that the "Phantom Thieves" may be responsible, and driven by the feeling that "I can't ignore someone in trouble", Anna and Mikuru transform into Cure Answer and Cure Mystique. Together, they become the Star Detective Precure, running the Cure It Detective Agency while solving mysteries and searching for a way for Anna to return to her original time.

name: La Fiera
summary: Natalie and Victor Alfonso must confront the social class differences that threaten their love. Witness what they are willing to overcome to find happiness.

name: Pobre Diabla
summary:
Daniela Montenegro and Santiago Rodríguez fall in love at first sight. However, the shadow of a tragic past casts a shadow over their story: Horacio, Santiago's father, murdered Daniela, Daniela's mother and the wife of his business partner and friend, Diego Montenegro, 20 years ago. To avoid prison and protect his family, Horacio manipulated the evidence to frame Diego, who was sentenced to 25 years in prison.

Now that Diego is about to be released, Horacio will do everything in his power to eliminate him, and Daniela and Santiago will find themselves caught in a struggle to reconcile their violent past and overcome other obstacles to consummate their love.

name: Mel Brooks: The 99 Year Old Man!
summary: Mel Brooks: The 99 Year Old Man! explores the life, career, friendships, and loves of legendary writer, director, producer, and performer, Mel Brooks. One of Hollywood's most daring satirists from the early years of television sketch comedy through his film and stage hits, Brooks has held a funhouse mirror up to the human condition and used laughter as a path to resilience, connection, and joy for nearly a century.

name: Gavilanes
summary: Three brothers seek revenge on the family who they think are responsible for the death of their younger sister, but have a change of heart when they fall in love.

previousepisode.name: Juan y Norma retoman su relación

name: Дорога на остров Пасхи
summary: On one sunny summer day Oleg Bardin (Egor Beroev) sets free from a maximum security prison. He had been imprisoned for 12 years for robbing a bank armored car and now only one thing he wants is to forget about the past and start a new life with Nadezhda - a woman who loves him - and his son Andrey. But stolen and missing 18 million dollars haunt many people. And there are a lot of bad people and bad troubles apart from Nadezhda waiting for Oleg at the prison gates. Eight days in which the action takes, turn upside down the life of almost all the characters. The film is full of conflicts, twists and turns, chases, sudden deaths and deep human love.

name: Take That
summary: The meteoric rise to fame. The break-up that broke hearts. The comeback that changed everything. How did five lads from Manchester rewrite pop history?

name: Ołowiane dzieci
summary: When a young doctor discovers that children living near a smelting plant suffer from lead poisoning, she risks her career and safety to save them.

name: The Art of Sarah
summary: A supposed luxury maven. A detective with a keen eye. As he digs into her shifting story, the truth behind a murder case slowly comes to light.

name: Kode rød
summary: Isolated on a deserted island, ten celebrities compete to handle a state of emergency. Each night, they must banish one person. Who will be the last survivor?

name: Agent Tørr
summary: Agent Tørr is an absurd crime parody. The series follows PST's legendary, but hopelessly clumsy special agent Harrbjørn Tørr, who is repeatedly brought out of retirement to save Norway.

name: Barbeint i snøen
summary: Barbeint i Snøen (en.: Barefoot in the Snow) is a powerful story about Lina and the dramatic events that occur. One November evening in 2022, a young Norwegian woman walks into a Swedish seaside hotel. She is scantily clad and not wearing shoes. The following evening, she is found naked and dead outside a summer house not far away. The murder alarm goes off.

name: Golden vs. Zuckerberg
summary:
Johan Golden is pissed!

He has been abused in a crypto scam on Facebook. Golden is therefore taking up the fight against one of the world's most powerful men. The new series "Golden vs. Zuckerberg" is a documentary series in which Johan Golden decides to sue the tech giant Meta. Golden reveals the dark sides of Meta's influence on the world and meets others who have been affected by the company's irresponsible practices.

It is not only Johan Golden who wants to hold Meta accountable. Before Christmas, it became clear that the Norwegian Media Association is also considering taking legal action against the tech giant. It is a massive problem that, according to Reuters, Meta earns around $16 billion annually on fraudulent ads.

name: Min vän shejken i Stureby
summary: Ulf's father invited Sheik Talal Al Saud to Sweden. Excited Ulf promised everyone on the block a real, live, Arab prince, not realizing there has been a change in plans. So now he's got to do something.

name: Mini Teuggongdae
summary: Four animal superheroes called the miniforce transform into robots to protect small and defenceless creatures from the hands of scheming villains.

name: Мистер Ноготь
summary: Semaga is a master of painting nesting dolls, an "old school" person: he loves wood, manual labor and an order in which a man is the head of the family. His track record includes the smallest matryoshka doll in Russia. But times are changing, Semaga is losing his job, and his wife Violetta is rising up the career ladder. Family relations are strained, the teenage daughter considers her father to be boring, and only the eight-year-old son still maintains a warm relationship with his dad. After being fired from the matryoshka workshop, Semaga feels like she is finally losing control of her own life. In a desperate attempt to regain the respect of his family, he decides to open a nail salon – together with his friend, the asshole Antokha. Confident that he can handle nails as easily as he can with nesting dolls, Semaga suddenly finds himself in the world of gel coatings and women's conversations. And this new experience is changing him more than he could have imagined.

name: Klin Kasalong
summary: In the first life, they are twins. The older one was called Kasalong who was raised by her mother who taught her to be sweet and gentle. She is also good at north dancing and household tasks. Since she is of good values and nature, everyone compared her to be godlike. The younger was called Songpeep raised by her father is cruel and selfish just like him, she was always jealous of Kasalong because she thought that her mother loved Kasalong more than her. She played the victim in all situations and would go around seducing guys who fought for her. She was the complete opposite of her sister even when it came down to simple things like their clothing. Since she was of these values, people always thought ill of her. Both of them tragically die. Songpeep is engulfed in fire due to her anger while Kasalong gets trapped and dies from malnutrition. In the second life, Songpeep was reborn as Pimpisa, the daughter of a wealthy doctor.

name: Cromwell in Ireland
summary: Oliver Cromwell is the great bogeyman of Irish history. His name appears everywhere in the collective psyche of the island. He is a towering figure, a dark silhouette against the bloodstained backdrop of history. But why did he come to Ireland, and does he deserve this black reputation? For the first time in this major television series we get a serious insight into Cromwell the man Cromwell -God's Executioner, is an epic but very real, gritty and bloody portrait of warfare in the 17th century.

name: Cara sucia
summary: Miguel Ángel is a member of one of the richest families in the city, while Estrellita is a poor, beautiful, and hardworking girl who sells newspapers to earn a living.

name: Uchû taitei Godsigma
summary:
The story is set in the year 2050 AD, and mankind has been steadily advancing its space technology. However, the planet is suddenly set upon by a mysterious enemy: the forces of Eldar, who came from 250 years in the future. In their time, 2300 AD, their planet Eldar was invaded by Earth, and soundly defeated by Earth's Trinity Energy, a mysterious energy used in their weaponry that possesses power many times that of a hydrogen bomb. The Eldar people's objective is to steal this Trinity Energy before it can be used against them.

The Eldar forces begin by taking over Jupiter's moon Io, one of the places humanity has immigrated to by then. After that, they begin to attack Trinity City with their legions of Cosmosauruses in order to steal the Trinity Energy. Toshiya and his friends use God Sigma to protect the planet and the Trinity Energy, and the battle evolves into a long war to retake Io.

name: Zeru Ahoak
summary: Nerea García is going through a rough patch. Four years have passed since she was expelled from the Ertzaintza (Basque police force), and she lives in isolation, confined to her home in Bilbao. The discovery of a woman's body, murdered in some kind of ritual, leads her former boss to ask for her help with the investigation.

previousepisode.name: El cielo es un mar sucio

name: Gåden i dybet
summary: When a centuries-old shipwreck is discovered in the depths off the coast of Copenhagen, historian Cecilie Nielsen sets out to discover what secrets the wreck holds. She closely follows the marine archaeologists from the Viking Ship Museum in Roskilde, who are faced with one of their most spectacular tasks in years: excavating and salvaging the ship. Together with Denmark's leading medieval researchers, historians and archaeologists, she tries to solve the mystery: What ship lies here? Where did it come from? Who sailed with it? And why did it end up here?

name: La Invasora
summary:
Mariana del Carmen Guerra is a humble young woman caught in a family drama when it's discovered that her stepfather secretly recorded intimate videos of her and posted them online. The situation escalates, complicating Mariana's life to the point where she has no choice but to run away from home.

Without intending to, and having never planned for such a fate, she ends up invading the dressing room of a cheerful young man, Sergio Martínez Aldana, without him noticing the unexpected intruder. Thus, in her unexpected struggle for survival, Mariana will meet the love of her life.

However, the story of these young lovers will not be a bed of roses. Mariana's arrival in Sergio's life will cause a series of disputes between the young man and his family. Because of these problems, Sergio will lose his inheritance and his family position, and will be rejected by his father.

From this complicated situation will emerge a wild and exciting love story.

name: Sálvame María
summary: María arrives in San Luis, Argentina, after a failed marriage. Battered by life, she seeks to reconnect with her roots, with part of her family, and ultimately, with her true self. What María doesn't know is that in this place she will rediscover love and that the possibility of becoming a mother will become increasingly real.

name: Nytt liv i gamle hus
summary: Do you dream of a house that needs a little extra love? Join Einar Nilsson as he visits families who are turning their dreams into a living reality.

name: Nasjonale turistvegar
summary: Join us on a trip! Meet the people, hear the stories and experience nature along our most spectacular stretches of road. This is a Norwegian holiday at its best!

name: Ligaen
summary: "The League" is a competition-driven comedy series where it's not enough to win - you have to challenge yourself and impress with both showmanship, creativity and humor.

name: Fascism in Colour
summary: A two-part film on Benito Mussolini and fascism, presented for the first time in colour. It is the story of fascism's violent roots, and its dream of restoring the glories of the Roman Empire. Benito Mussolini became well known as the leader of the National Fascist Party and the main founder of fascism after his return from WWI. The war had altered his outlook on life; once a reformer, he became obsessed with the idea of power and started to refer to himself as Il Duce. His apparent successes and glorification of violence encouraged Adolf Hitler to organise Germany on the same fascist principles. "FASCISM IN COLOUR" provides a fascinating yet disturbing account of Il Duce's desire for power, his totalitarian dictatorship and his alliance with Hitler that led to the death of 55 million people. Based on descriptions of events written at the time; letters, diary entries, secret memos and telephone taps, this is a truly remarkable record of the man who ultimately became Hitler's pawn. Rare archival colour footage keeps Il Duce's arrogance and his ruthless rule of violence, intimidation and murder very much alive. Produced and Directed by Chris Oxley ; An IWC Media co-production for Channel Five in association with Discovery Channel

name: Celtic Monsters
summary: Ancient Celtic tales featuring magical beasts, presented by poet and singer Twm Morys

name: Battleplan
summary: Battleplan is a military-based television documentary series examing the various military strategies used in modern warfare, since World War I. Each episode looks at a particular military strategy (or "battleplan") used in warfare, through two well-known historical examples and compares them both with the military requirements needed in order to conduct that "Battleplan". All the episodes use examples from modern warfare, dating from the First World War (1914–18) up to the recent Iraq War (2003).

name: Gimbap and Onigiri
summary: Hase Taiga who has been working part-time at the small restaurant "Tanomi" for three years, was once a promising young man as the ace of the university's relay team, but his past was ruined by poor performance. Although he doesn't have any particular dreams at the moment, he is beginning to feel a sense of fulfilment in his work, such as being entrusted by the owner with coming up with new menu items. Meanwhile, Park Rin, from South Korea, a graduate student studying animation is busy working on her assignments. Just when she feels relieved after somehow managing to submit her assignment just before the deadline, she receives a notice to move out of her student dormitory... However, for a foreigner, finding housing in Japan is not an easy task, and she is exhausted both physically and mentally... Then the two have a chance encounter at Tanomi. Rin is moved by the onigiri Taiga serves her, and her hunger and tiredness are gradually satisfied. Taiga is captivated by Rin's smile as she eats them deliciously. And the moment their eyes meet, an irresistible thrill flows between them.

name: The Daughter of the Demon Lord Is Too Kind!
summary:
The Demon King Ahriman, once the undisputed ruler of the demon realm and conqueror of countless worlds, suddenly halts his campaigns—troubled by an unexpected problem: his daughter, Doux, is just too kindhearted. Determined to turn her into a ruthless and fearsome demon worthy of the throne, his loyal aide Jahi steps up with a plan. Thus begins a heartwarming and comedic fantasy, where the adorable demon girl Doux faces one trial after another—only to solve each one with the power of kindness and healing.

name: Geração Brasil
summary: After launching a low-cost computer in the US, Jonas Marra becomes one of the world's leading technology entrepreneurs. Mysteriously, he decides to return to Brazil 20 years later.

name: Tisícrocná vcela
summary: A multigenerational saga (1887-1917) parallels a bee colony, with the queen representing family roots and tradition. The Pichanda family faces love, work, crisis, and war, weaving reality with dreams.

name: ¿Dónde está Elisa?
summary: A teenager disappears causing her family's world to turn upside down. In the police quest to find her, all her relatives will become suspects of her kidnapping.

name: ¡Ala... Dina!
summary: Follow the adventures of Dina, a genie who after 500 years locked in a lamp, is released and joins a widower and his two children, and finds that everyone has something to hide.

name: บ่วงเสน่หา
summary: Mintra feels like she's in a fairytale when she finds the perfect guy to marry, Peem. But Jack, a charming model, shows up at their wedding ceremony without invitation. He and Peem are secretly lovers and now Jack is the presenter of the new product Peem's company is launching. Everything changes as soon as Jack comes into Mintra's life. She knows that Peem is having an affair with him, but can't get a divorce since she needs money for her sister's treatment. She finds confort in Ton, her junior, who's secretly in love with her. Meanwhile Jack is angry that Mintra is disrupting his relationship with Peem, and tries to get her out the way, but she won't back down in the hope that Jack will give up. Peem refuses to choose between the 2, and forces them all to live together, uncaring of Jack and Mintra's feelings.

name: Yodrak Nakrob
summary: The story is about an Isan singer named Yodrak who ends up taking the place of a marine officer who vanished due to the two looking very similar to one another as if they were twins. Because of their differing personalities and skills, people start to suspect him, especially his fiancée who happens to be a doctor for the navy.

name: Lady Joker
summary: A suspicious audio CD is delivered to Shiroyama Kyosuke, president of Hinode Beer, exposing the company's past wrongdoings. Meanwhile, a group of men—including Monoi Seizo, a pharmacy owner, and Handa Shuhei, a detective—plot to steal money from Hinode Beer. Detective Goda Yuichiro investigates Shiroyama's disappearance, only to find a note saying, "The company president is in our custody." Shiroyama is soon released, and a criminal group, Lady Joker, claims to have poisoned 3.5 kilolitres of beer, demanding 2 billion yen from the company.

name: Jao Sao Chapor Kit
summary: Poom Rattanabodin hires Yai Mangeaw as his wife to stand in place of his girlfriend, Deurnchai Chattrakorn, while she is in school abroad in Japan. He hires her so that he wouldn't have to be forced to marry the girl, Prakaifah Sopapan, that his parents want him to marry. As the story goes on, Poom starts to fall in love with Yai and so does she, but she tries not to fall in love with him because his girlfriend is her best friend and she owes her friend a great value because of an issue that she and her family helped solve.

name: Blue Skies
summary:
Blue Skies is an all-new procedural series blending mystery, action, and emotional storytelling, centered on the powerful bond between a detective and her canine companion.

Set in the stunning Crystal Ridge National Park, the series follows former military police officer Jodi Larsen as she returns to her hometown to serve as a criminal investigator for the National Park Police. As Jodi protects the park and its visitors from both natural and human threats, she navigates a new team, personal loss, and an unexpected partnership with Blue, a mischievous stray Labrador whose instincts prove invaluable in solving cases.

The canine, Blue, a golden Labrador Retriever is played by three brothers, River, Comet and Canyon. River is considered the "star" of the three.

name: Máximo corazón
summary: This is the story of Máximo, a man who falls in love with the woman who has been transplanted the heart of his dead wife, killed in an accident.

name: Conexión salvaje
summary: Wild Connection is a documentary series that explores the intricate biological and geological links between distant regions of the planet, specifically focusing on the Iberian Peninsula and Central America. The series chronicles the dramatic formation of landscapes, such as the closing of the Isthmus of Panama, and tracks how these events allowed for the migration and evolution of a diverse array of species, from the Spanish ibex and brown bears in Europe to jaguars and monkeys in the tropics. By examining these "forgotten places" and unique splendors, the show illustrates how isolation and connection have shaped the earth's most fascinating animal worlds across two different hemispheres.

name: This Is the Feeling of Love
summary: When a scandal-ready queen in trouble meets a mysterious, two-faced "knight," who will fall first? He becomes her personal assistant, but is he after something, or is he the one falling for her? When a quirky little "witch" falls for a cold-faced hacker, is it really one-sided, or are they both running toward the same love? Ever met someone who makes your heart pound like a startled deer? When sparks feel like destiny, will you dare to chase true love?

name: Земский доктор
summary: Young doctor Olga leaves a prestigious work in Moscow and moves to provincial town to become the doctor in the small local hospital.

name: Бывшая жена
summary: A single mother quits her career as a professional singer to become a bounty hunter chasing down deadbeats dads.

name: Human Nature
summary: Award-winning evolutionary biologist Dan Riskin attempts to understand the mysteries of the mind that make us human in brand new series ‘Human Nature'. Travelling around the globe, Dan takes a detailed look at different aspects of the human psyche, from our relationship to fear, to the significance, power and potential of memory.

name: Królowa Bona
summary: Life of Bona Sforza, 16th century Italian princess from Bari, who became wife of king Sigismundus I the Old and queen consort of Commonwealth of Poland and Lithuania.

name: The Postcard Bandit
summary: Forty robberies, two escapes, 28 years behind bars. Uncover the truth behind Australia's most infamous fugitive, Brenden Abbott. This is the real story behind BINGE Original RUN.

name: ¿Dónde está Elisa?
summary: A teenage girl disappears after a party, sparking an intense search that uncovers dark family secrets. As a detective struggles to solve the case, the apparent stability of the wealthy León family begins to crumble.

name: 90 Day: The Single Life - Between the Sheets
summary: 90 Day: The Single Life - Between the Sheets will air after each episode as a companion show, serving up all the juicy extras. Cast members, their former spouses/exes, plus family and friends spill behind-the-scenes drama, share unfiltered reactions, and say what everyone else is thinking.

name: The Coach Vick Experience
summary: The Coach Vick Experience is an emotional, high-stakes docuseries that follows Michael Vick as he returns home to Virginia for the biggest challenge of his life — stepping in as a first-time head coach tasked with reigniting Norfolk State's struggling football program. With the community and the season on the line, Coach Vick must learn the job in real time while building a team hungry for greatness. At its core, this is more than football - it's a raw and inspiring look at what it takes to rebuild a program, a culture, and the belief that anything is possible.

name: O Canto da Sereia
summary: Meet Sereia, a young and beautiful singer whose world of fame and fortune is interlaced with envy and hate. Her murder in the midst of carnival shocks the entire country and the hunt for her killer reveals a new suspect with each new day of investigation. Holding the status of a big-budget thriller, the miniseries brings about mysticism, sensuality and suspense that hooks the viewer until the astonishing end.

name: Maszyna zmian
summary: An adventure series for young viewers. A group of children, accompanied by their guardian, Filip, arrive at a sanatorium for allergy sufferers. Inside an old piano, they discover stairs to a hidden room containing a mysterious device. It's a Change Machine. Whatever, or whoever, is placed inside it transforms into something entirely different. The children's guardian takes on the role of guinea pig in an intriguing experiment. He enters the Machine. Moments later, a real rabbit emerges from the device.

name: La Terre vue du ciel
summary: Earth from Above is a series of documentaries, presented by Yann Arthus-Bertrand and dedicated to the major challenges faced by our planet, It was broadcast on France 2 and France 3, French national television. "Earth From Above" brings the viewer beautiful High Definition images of the Earth. Each episodes talks about a particular environmental challenge.

name: Whale Adventure with Nigel Marven
summary: Film-maker Nigel Marven goes on an epic journey following the journey of grey whales on their 5,000-mile migration.

name: As Noivas de Copacabana
summary: A resident of Copacabana and Cinara's fiancé, Donato lives a life above suspicion. But he is actually a serial killer, obsessed with women dressed as brides.

name: Narco Mennonites
summary: For decades, a quiet Mennonite farming community in Canada hid a secret no one saw coming: a family-run drug empire stretching from rural Ontario to the mountains of Chihuahua, Mexico. NARCO MENNONITES uncovers the astonishing rise of the Harms family, the original architects of the "Mennonite Mafia," and the violent new generation that followed. Through insight from insiders, traffickers, and pursuing law enforcement, the series reveals how a peaceful religious community became an unexpected pipeline for cartel power.

name: Dirty Talk: When Daytime Talk Shows Ruled TV
summary: A look back at the rise, fall and lasting impact of the most sensational era in TV talk show history. By exploring the psychological forces that shaped the talk TV genre, the series reveals how these shows transformed from trusted confessional spaces into lightning rods of controversy, leaving a lasting impact on culture, media and the people caught in the chaos.

name: Maryada: Lekin Kab Tak?
summary: Story of a girl who tries to take out the bitter truth of her life but fall in love with someone whose family member constantly reminds her past.

name: После школы
summary: «После школы» is an innovative blend of storylines and lyrical digressions, embedded video clips and musical interludes, comedic techniques and detective twists, stylizations and parodies. The film's soundtrack consists of iconic nostalgic retro compositions and ultra‑modern, upbeat songs.

name: Мульт личности
summary: Biweekly 3-D animation TV show poking fun at public figures

name: The Apprentice: Unfinished Business
summary: A look behind the curtain of The Apprentice to analyse every task and tactic in detail as Lord Sugar searches for a new business partner.

name: Guanabis
summary: Five boys are influenced by social stigmas, the media, money, and the aspiration to circles of power.

name: Misión Celebridades
summary: Misión Celebridades (MC) was a television program and a reality-format music album created in Mexico by producer brothers Ricardo Tavera and Armando Tavera under their production company Glat Entertainment. The project was part of Televisa Networks, airing on various channels and featuring interviews with young personalities who shared their life stories and their journey toward becoming established figures and international celebrities.

name: Кодекс молчания
summary: A detective and friend probe a 1980 drug mafia murder in Uzbekistan after official investigation is blocked. Despite forced retirement, they catch killers but face resistance exposing kingpins.

name: Высокий перевал
summary: Yaroslava "Slavka" Petryn, avid communist whose family was torn apart by World War II returns to her village as a party leader only to find that her family are among nationalists which terrorize the village.

name: Russia's Wild Sea
summary: The Sea of Okhotsk lies between the Kamchatka Peninsula and the Japanese island of Hokkaido: the last and greatest unspoiled ocean on Earth.

name: Weird Creatures with Nick Baker
summary: In collaboration with the British Natural History Museum, wildlife expert Nick Baker takes us to some of the most remote and inhospitable corners of the globe to find the ugliest, slimiest and most bizarre animals.

name: La Certosa Di Parma
summary: The love story of 2 youths during the '700s. Fabrizio, a boy who was supposed to be a noble and part of Napoleons army, and Clelia a beautiful girl of a important Noble of the high society of Parma in that era. Their love became impossible because of the Presence of other characters and they personal desires

name: Las Malcriadas
summary: Five women are hired by a placement housemaid agency, but it actually functions as a criminal organization dedicated to trafficking in persons.

name: Asteroid Rush
summary: 65 million years ago, asteroids contributed to the disappearance of 80% of animals on Earth, including dinosaurs. Today, they pose a real threat. Every day, an average of 230 asteroids are on a collision course with our planet and are undetected by radars. Are we prepared for asteroids? How can we prevent future disasters?

name: Кривое зеркало
summary: Monthly multi-genre show of the comedic theatre led by Evgeny Petrosyan.

name: Pinocchio
summary: A piece of pine-wood is carved into a puppet by a poor old toy maker. The puppet suddenly comes to life for feeling exciting adventures along with a female wood cricket.

name: 4 Blocks Zero
summary: The prequel to the award-winning gangster drama ‘4 Blocks' tells the story of the Hamadys in 1990s Berlin: having fled Lebanon and only accepted as tolerated refugees in Germany, they struggle to gain a foothold in their new home. Who are they, how did the family become the most influential clan in the city, and how did Ali eventually become Toni?

name: Lush Mountains
summary: In early 1977, at the No. 13 Telecommunications Factory in central Shandong, young worker Lu Xiaoqing is widely recognized as an exemplary model employee. In an era filled with passion and devotion—when people believed in "going wherever the nation needs, dedicating youth and even a lifetime to the Third Front"—she meets and falls in love with fellow factory worker Hong Yuanshan. However, their relationship faces fierce opposition from Hong's mother. After enduring countless setbacks, Lu Xiaoqing eventually builds a new life with Gong Tianliang, while she and Hong Yuanshan are separated forever. That same year, China's long-suspended college entrance examination (Gaokao) is reinstated. Determined to pursue greater personal value, Lu Xiaoqing, along with Zuo Hongwei, Zhao Cungen, and others, chooses to take on the challenge of the Gaokao and seek higher education. They devote the best years of their lives to the "Small Third Front" and the country's socialist modernization, witnessing the factory's journey through glory, decline, and rebirth across major historical transformations—from the Third Front construction to Reform and Opening Up, and even Hong Kong's return. Their lives become a lasting tribute and proud imprint of an extraordinary era.

name: Soul Power: The Legend of the American Basketball Association
summary:
Soul Power: The Legend of the American Basketball Association is about the rise and fall of the American Basketball Association—a league that defined one of America's most turbulent eras and shaped the NBA as we know it today. 

Soul Power is the definitive story—and first docuseries—of the American Basketball Association. The series chronicles the 1967 launch of the enterprising league and explores how a collection of franchises—the majority of which relocated or folded—challenged the NBA on and off the court for nine riveting seasons, and examines the lasting impact of the ABA on the sport of basketball, including the introduction of the 3-point shot; the All-Star Game slam dunk competition; the addition of former ABA franchises like the Brooklyn Nets, Denver Nuggets, Indiana Pacers, and San Antonio Spurs to the NBA; empowering women to play a more substantial role in the business of sports; and the rise to fame of superstar players and pro hoops contributors like Julius Erving, Moses Malone, Spencer Haywood, George Gervin, Rick Barry, and George Karl. 2026 marks the 50th anniversary of the ABA's merger with the NBA. 

Soul Power showcases how a bold, short-lived league permanently reshaped professional basketball, player empowerment, and American sports culture. Told through the voices of legends, cultural leaders, and historians, the series argues that modern basketball looks the way it does because the ABA existed.

name: De Hygiënepolitie
summary: Based on poor online reviews, Rob Geus checks hygiene at hotels, restaurants, and other locations. He confronts owners and offers a solution. But will they cooperate?

name: Queen of Mars
summary: It is the year 2125. Four decades have passed since human habitation began on Mars. Here, "stability" is a foreign concept. Under authoritarian rule by ISDA (the Inter-planetary Space Development Agency), discontent is brewing. Mars is silently in turmoil. In this atmosphere, "it" suddenly appears. And with it comes inexplicable supernatural phenomena. Who created it? Why is it here? And what does it mean for humankind? Hope? Catastrophe? Lili E1102 is visually impaired. Born and raised on Mars, she endured grueling training to board the spaceship bound for Earth. She is determined to meet someone: Shiraishi Aoto, the young Earthling ISDA scientist. The two have a secret pact no one knows about. But on the day of departure, Lili is struck by disaster. And this triggers accelerated machinations on both Earth and Mars... And all is connected to "it"... This is a story of people who fight against the unknown.

name: Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi
summary: Kanan the "Gourmet Devil" has descended upon the human world with one goal: to gorge herself on youthful souls. Her first target is high schooler Youji Kyougi—except her plan backfires horribly! Instead of her meal, he's now her…boyfriend?! Even though she's lived for thousands of years, Kanan has never known love! Can a devil survive the dangers of dates, hand-holding, and her very first romance?

previousepisode.name: Kanan and Kyougi's Trial of Love

name: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
summary: Sasaki was an overworked salaryman who goes through an average stressful work day like any other salaryman. Upon finishing a long day, the only thing Sasaki enjoys is visiting his favorite convenience store to have a friendly chat with the always cheerful clerk Yamada. This was a regular routine for Sasaki, but one day he ended up working slightly longer at his job and by the time he visited the convenience store, Yamada had already clocked out. Sasaki was about to leave the store until he noticed a young woman with piercings smoking behind the store.

previousepisode.name: Keeping It Going Behind the Supermarket with You

name: La Quête d'Ewilan
summary: At just 13, Camille's life takes a dramatic turn when she is accidentally hurled into the world of Gwendalavir, inhabited by creatures as extraordinary as they are dangerous. She and her friend Salim discover her real name, Ewilan. She learns the truth about her roots and her fate: a native of Gwendalavir, she has inherited a prodigious talent, designing. This turns out to be a decisive weapon in her people's struggle with the terrible Ts'lich. Ewilan's arrival brings fresh hope for saving an embattled world. Imagination will be her only limit.

name: La Certosa di Parma - Lo sceneggiato
summary: In 1982, director Mauro Bolognini adapted Stendhal's "La certosa di Parma" into a six-part drama. Faithful to the novel, Bolognini's work brought to the screen Fabrizio Del Dongo's political ideals and historical disappointments, as well as his unforgettable love story with Clelia.

previousepisode.name: Gaan we met Gen-Z de oorlog winnen? - Als de Russen komen

name: Muévete
summary:
"Muévete" was a Mexican television entertainment program produced by Televisa. The show focused on music, dance, and youth-oriented entertainment, featuring live performances, choreography, interviews, and interactive segments. It was designed to promote popular Latin music and an energetic lifestyle.

Maribel Guardia appeared on the program as one of its well-known hosts and performers, bringing her charisma, beauty, and experience in entertainment. Her presence helped make the show appealing to a broad audience, combining glamour with lively musical content. The program became known for its colorful sets, upbeat atmosphere, and emphasis on movement and fun, which matched its title, "Muévete" ("Move Yourself").

name: Dirty Business
summary:
Based on a decade-long investigation into England's water companies, and telling the real stories of whistleblowers and victims who believe their lives have been destroyed after encountering sewage polluted water, Dirty Business is a major new factual drama investigating one of the biggest potential corporate scandals in British history.

Dirty Business follows the story of two unlikely detectives, who notice that the fish in the river running through their idyllic Oxfordshire hamlet are dying. They contact their water company to find out why, and the company's strange and evasive reply sparks an investigation that remains ongoing to this day.

name: Forever Home
summary: The series follows the story of a second wife dealing with the memories of the woman who went before her. When Carol discovers a long-dead body hidden in the basement of her home, the horrific realisation is undeniable – she's living with a killer. The story that her husband's first wife ran away never to be seen again now looks like a lie, and the fact he's insisted on never selling the house suddenly makes sense. But one dark family secret is soon to be replaced by another…

name: Guz Khan's Custom Cars
summary: Guz Khan revs up for a wild ride in the world of car modification.

name: Fear Not
summary:
A true-crime drama about Margy Palm, the last woman kidnapped by prolific serial killer Stephen Morin before he was caught. Morin's abduction of Palm, which started as a deadly captive situation, took an unlikely turn: one which included compassion, prayer and profound courage.

Palm's devotion to her faith and her insistence that Morin could be transformed became the impetus of a relationship that lasted long after Palm was returned to safety — until Morin received the death penalty

name: Wo Ye Ye Dang Xin Niang
My Love Burns Only For You
The Ride Life
summary: Sung Kang, known for his role of Han in the Fast and the Furious franchise, embarks on a global journey to delve into the fascinating world of cars. This series explores car culture, uncovering the compelling stories behind the vehicles and the individuals who drive, design, and create them. Traveling to renowned car capitals from London and Tokyo, Sung connects with people who offer unique perspectives and captivating tales about cars and their cultural significance to various communities.

name: The Far Cry Experience
summary: Taking place days before Far Cry 3, Christopher Mintz-Plasse is captured by Vaas and his gang of pirates where he becomes the subject of Vaas's torture show.

name: Time-Travelling Dinosaur Knights
summary: The anime series take dinosaurs as the core and tell the science fiction adventure stories of ""past, future and present"" in the city of Zigong in three different spacetimes. Fascinating stories show the protagonists' moral concern for the Earth and life community, conveying the values of humanity, fraternity, dedication, and the constant salvation of the people. It revolves around the adventures of the Dinosaur Defenders in prehistoric past ： In order to save dinosaurs and protect the past, present and future of Zigong, they battled against the dark forces of Star's Army. and ends in a spectacular finale with Star defeated and dead but the dinosaurs' world in ruins and the portal closing (presumably) forever...

name: Apparences
summary: Bordeaux. A cosmetic surgeon, Dr. Belmont, is found dead in a gruesome scene in the parking lot of the clinic where he practiced with his two partners and friends. For Captain Sarah Santoni, this investigation quickly becomes deeply sensitive: she herself underwent reconstructive facial surgery following a violent assault. And the victim, Dr. Belmont… is the very man who operated on her and helped her overcome her trauma. Soon, a prime suspect emerges: Jessica, a young woman partially disfigured by the same surgeon. Her desire to resemble her influencer idols has turned into a tragedy. Meanwhile, alongside the investigation, Gabrielle, a renowned investigative journalist and natural beauty, takes a keen interest in the world of cosmetic surgery. A world that sells dreams, but can also turn into a nightmare.

name: Nam Pueng Kom
summary: Purim was brutally hurt in love when his lover, Rose, dumped him for a wealthy man and never saw him again. Purim, on the other hand, never forgot the pain that was inflicted on him by Rose and always felt the desire to get revenge. As years passed, Purim became a wealthy businessman while Rose became an alcoholic and gambler. One day the fate of the two collided again and seeing an opportunity for revenge Purim made Rose sell her daughter Kungsadarn to him as a wife in return of paying her gambling debt. After their marriage,Purim slowly starts to see the goodness in Kungsadarn and warm feelings begin to develop in his heart. However... there are other obstacles that are ahead in their path.

name: The Crimson Blade
summary: Ye Qingling, an illegitimate daughter of the Ye family, is forced to marry the critically ill heir of a noble house. On their wedding night, the heir suddenly dies, and she narrowly escapes being sacrificed as a burial companion for the Grand Princess. To survive, she risks approaching her cold-hearted brother-in-law, Wei Hengzhi, through a fake pregnancy scheme and careful schemes. Yet, she becomes entangled in a forbidden attraction between sister-in-law and brother-in-law, and a whirlpool of political intrigue. In the end, Wei Hengzhi's true identity as a hidden royal prince is revealed. Together, they crush the conspiracy. He ascends the throne as emperor, and she becomes his empress.

name: Mu Wang Zhi Wang
summary: Luo Wu Zi helped Li Si Xiu to build the mound of Qin Shi Huang; the first emperor who united China. His disciples continued to build and safeguard the royal tombstone. In between lies the appearance of the Nine Great Tombstones, also known as Great King of the Graves. For thousands of years, the tombs were never robbed. The outsiders regard these guardians of the tombs like the Tomb Sect. After the death of Luo Wu Zi, the position of Grave King is transferred to his eldest disciple, Mu Rong Xiu.

name: Silent Truth
summary: When a detective returns to his hometown to investigate a murder case, he uncovers shocking connections to the primary suspect and the weapon.

name: Щит и меч: легенды госбезопасности
summary: The work of the state security agencies is not visible to the average person, but it is in the hands of their employees that the peace of our citizens is ensured. Unknown details of legendary operations and unique fates in our series of documentaries "Shield and Sword: Legends of State Security." We will tell not only about intelligence and sabotage operations and the work of state security agencies during the Great Patriotic War, but also about events in recent history.

name: Ленинградский фронт
summary: The four‑part documentary film is a unique project by Channel Five: for the first time in the post‑war years, viewers of all generations will have the opportunity to learn about the tragic and heroic details of one of the greatest battles of World War II — the Battle of Leningrad.

name: The Long Snake Takes A Wife
summary: Bai Zhongtian's mother died under mysterious circumstances in his childhood. Locals whispered she was taken by the "Elder Immortal." Years later, he returns to Baiyun Town, a place shrouded in eerie folklore that phantom weddings of the Long Snake Immortal, paper-cut summoning rituals, ghostly opera troupes, and the haunting legend of the red-paper umbrella. When a villager witnesses another spectral wedding in the mountains, Bai Zhongtian embarks on a chilling investigation to unveil the truth behind the myths.

name: She Rules The World Below
summary: The celestial being Wen Shu descends to the mortal realm to undergo her trial of tribulation. She aids Zhang Shiming in resurrecting his sister and exposes the true culprit, Li Shuhao. From there, she goes on to crack dark sorcery, soothe vengeful spirits, and battle the undying Bone Refined, enduring the Trial of the Seven Emotions along the way. In the end, Tushan Jin sacrifices himself to save her, and Wen Shu, having fully awakened to the depths of human feeling, reclaims her immortal throne. But when Tushan Jin's body vanishes without a trace, Wen Shu receives a new decree: return to the mortal world and settle the karma once and for all.

name: Rise Again
summary: After three hundred years of waiting, Immortal King Su Wubing and Holy Maiden Lin Ningxue held their celestial wedding, only to be stopped by the Heavenly Dao. To protect Wubing, Ningxue sacrificed herself, and they fell into endless reincarnation. A thousand lifetimes later, Wubing awakened in modern Fan City, while Ningxue was forced into marriage with the Gu family to save her father. Wubing crashed her wedding and resisted the Gu Group's oppression. With allies like Ye Tianmiao and his granddaughter Ye Xiaonuan, Wubing fought against the Gu family's schemes, cured Ningxue's father and broke the Heavenly Dao's curse. After trials like the Immortal Seeking Tournament, where Wubing claimed the Heavenly God Sword, he and Ningxue finally broke free from reincarnation and reunited. The story ended in a chaotic yet heartfelt wedding crash, revealing that after ten thousand years of struggle, nothing mattered more than an ordinary life together.

name: Студенты
summary: Evgeny Korolev arrives in Moscow by train and meets his future friend there - a red-haired first-year student Vladimir Vladimirovich Kvakusha. In addition to this guy with a funny last name, Zhenya recognizes Sasha, the head of the first-year students, who falls in love with him without memory. However, Zhenya himself falls in love with a third-year student, Veronika, whose boyfriend, Anton Sedykh, has great ties with the deputy dean Pavel Ilyich Gusev. As for Gusev, he hates Dean Vesnovsky and wants to take his place with all his might. Gusev's behavior affected not only teachers and students, but also Evgenia: he was once expelled from the student dormitory. However, he remembers that he has a friend Kvakusha, who is always ready to help him: the whole problem is that Kvakusha is a master at creating problems, and it is very difficult to solve them later.

name: Tian Jiang Zai Zai Qian Yin Yuan
Victory in Love
summary: Lin Zhanhong, the queen of the workplace, and Wen Yushi, the "newly appointed director," start as weekend lovers with a deal: cooperation only, no feelings involved. As they stand together against internal power plays at the company, their arrangement slowly turns into real love. When Wen's hidden identity as the "company heir" and a formidable love rival come to light, they face a crisis of trust. But through it all, they confirm their true feelings, tear down their defenses, and emerge victorious in love and work.

name: The Mismatched Marriage
summary: On her wedding night, a cruel prank spirals out of control, revealing her husband Lu Ze's weakness and cowardice. When Xiao Ying fights back and accidentally injures someone, the couple flees to a remote mountain village, where they are taken in by the retired soldier Yu Fu. As the marriage falls apart, Xiao Ying is gradually drawn to Yu Fu's steadiness, while Lu Ze sinks deeper into obsession and paranoia. Confronted by harsh realities, Xiao Ying finally awakens, breaking free from a misaligned marriage and stepping into a new life that truly belongs to her.

name: I Have A Male Fox
summary: The Fox Spirit Emporium deals in fox spirits of various cultivations, but Jin Xian, the sole male fox, is the only eccentric one who strayed from the norm—he only helps people achieve sudden wealth, refusing any trade in romance. Jiang Ci, recently wounded by love, crosses paths with Jin Xian. She knows all too well that love can give her nothing, while wealth will never betray her. And so begins an urban fantasy tale of sweet and whimsical romance, one woven with "money" and "desire."

name: Da Lao Gong Ying Tuan Chong Lao Zu Zong San Qian Sui
Lian Qi Lian Le San Qian Nian
The Hidden Truth
summary: Young detective Tang Tang, under the guidance of his mentor, is drawn into the reinvestigation of the Naked Banquet Case, a dark mystery that has haunted the city for fifteen years. The sudden resurfacing of the former ringleader, Bai Qiming, puts the Qingcheng police on high alert. But as surveillance intensifies, what begins as a hunt for a fugitive soon unravels into a sprawling criminal web. The investigation exposes the Bagong Dog Shelter, which exploits public goodwill for illicit profit under the guise of animal rescue while maintaining deep and sinister ties to Bai's syndicate. At the same time, a series of violent dog thefts ignites public panic when poisoned bait harms elderly residents and children. Every thread—from a restaurant owner's fatal mistake to the unexplained disappearance of a homeless man—leads back to the elusive Bai. As these seemingly unrelated cases converge, Tang Tang gradually uncovers the hidden truth. But just as the picture becomes clear, his childhood sweetheart is kidnapped, forcing him to confront the shocking reality that the mastermind behind the chaos is the one person he never suspected.

name: Late to Love
summary: Medical PhD Xu Nange is forced into a delayed graduation and ends up in a whirlwind contract marriage with powerful business magnate Huo Beiyan. He needs a wife to secure his family's control over the empire. She needs the marriage for reasons of her own. Before the world, they are the picture-perfect power couple. Behind closed doors, they are locked in a battle of hidden agendas. In a marriage built on calculation, deception, and danger, can two guarded hearts really fall in love?

name: Cousins
summary: Charlotte Uhlenbroek explores the world of the primates - our closest relatives.

name: Vila Madalena
summary: The soap opera Vila Madalena, named after the São Paulo neighborhood it passes through, tells the story of two couples whose fates intertwine after an unexpected turn of events.

name: Mannen under trappan
summary: Fredrik moves with his family into a new house in an idyllic spot. He notices, however, quickly that something is not right and that they don't seem to be alone in the new house. Frederick discovers one night that they have a mysterious inherent named Kwådd who seem to live in a cavity under the stairs and the stressful situation, putting a strain on the job and his family.

name: «Нева» и «Надежда». Первое русское плавание кругом света
Italian Restaurant
summary: Giulio Broccoli, an Italian immigrant living in New York City. Just as Giulio is prepared to return to Italy, his friend Mancuso tricks him into buying a half-share of a failing restaurant and disappears with his savings. Forced to stay and manage the business to recover his losses, Giulio forms an uneasy but eventually affectionate partnership with Mancuso's daughter, Connie, and her young daughter, Angie.

name: Love In Protocol
summary: Jeong Yeon joins the research lab of Yu Geon, his former private tutor, as an intern. However, Yu Geon's attitude upon their reunion is cold. An experiment that studies emotions, and two people facing each other once again. Subtle waves begin to ripple between Jeong Yeon and Yu Geon.

previousepisode.name: So I Came Back All Grown Up

name: Snow Leopards of Leafy London
summary: Hidden behind a rural farm shop on the edge of London's greenbelt is a secret world of snow leopards and other wild cats.

name: Наука на колесах
summary: There are experiments that you never dare to perform: how to beat a police radar, what happens if one blows up a rusty car? Science on the Wheels realizes your wildest dreams.

name: Historia kina polskiego 1895-2014
summary: A series of twelve lectures by Professor Tadeusz Lubelski, presented in September 2014, based on the book "Historia kina polskiego. 1895-2014." The lectures premiered at the 40th Gdynia Film Festival. We recommend them to anyone wishing to expand their knowledge of Polish cinema, particularly to students and teachers. They also provide excellent material for use in film education programs. The recording was created at the initiative of the Polish Film Institute, as part of the Polish Film Academy program, in collaboration with the WFDiF, the Polish Filmmakers Association, and the UNIVERSITAS Publishing House.

name: Belle Collective: Birmingham
summary: CEO and beauty mogul Stormi Steele, beloved by viewers of Love & Marriage: Huntsville, returns to television bolder than ever after a hyper-focused two-year break scaling her multimillion-dollar empire and wildly successful brand, Canvas Beauty. In Belle Collective: Birmingham, Stormi connects with a circle of driven, successful southern Belles in the rising cultural hub of Birmingham who are determined to transform the city into a thriving destination for beauty and influence. Stormi must navigate Birmingham's deeply connected social and business scenes to forge alliances with fellow powerhouses including her savvy CFO Amber Jones, entrepreneur Tiffaney Jones, marketing strategist Funmi Ford, model and marketer Synetta Hawkins, and talent manager K'La Inman.

name: Rothaí an tSaoil
summary:
In Rothaí an tSaoil, Donegal broadcaster Áine Ní Bhreisleáin meets people who offer a revealing and engaging look at life in contemporary Ireland. In each episode, Áine delves into fascinating conversations and personal reflections to uncover stories of challenges, losses and triumphs with characters who have reached key milestones in their lives.

Guided by Áine's warmth, curiosity and natural gift for listening, guests speak openly and honestly about their lives, their challenges and their hopes for the future. Each episode follows Áine on engaging journeys with her guests, sharing experiences, adventures and conversations in places that are central to who they are.

Drawn from diverse backgrounds and life paths, these unique voices offer a fresh and authentic insight into life in Ireland today. Together, Áine and her guests explore the questions that shape us all — what defines us, what sustains us, and what inspires us — as they reflect on resilience, loss, joy and the search for peace and happiness.

name: 120 Hours Behind Bars
summary: Over five intense days, 120 Hours Behind Bars delivers an unfiltered look inside America's toughest jails, where officers are outnumbered, cellblocks are overcrowded, and violence erupts without warning.

name: Petals of Reincarnation
summary:
There exists an object known as the "Branch of Reincarnation" that can grant people the talents of the past lives, so long as they slit their own throat with it.

Toya Senji is a teenage boy struggling with low self-esteem after growing up in the shadow of his gifted older brother. He comes to the decision that academic studies are his last resort in the search for talent, but fails to find satisfaction despite constantly placing in the top 100 for national mock exams.

In a twist of fate, Toya encounters one of his classmates, Haito Luo Buffett, a "Returner" who has resurrected the talents of her past life using the Branch of Reincarnation, as she fights against a serial killer.

name: Road
summary: The original work is the Korean-Japanese co-produced comic "Blue Road." The original story follows Korean detective Kang Cheong-do and Japanese detective Ino Se as they investigate bizarre murders that occurred in both Korea and Japan.

name: Czarna śmierć
summary: The series begins on May 22, 1963, in Wrocław. When Łucja Winter concludes her foreign intelligence mission, no one expected the capital of Lower Silesia to become the epicenter of a deadly infectious disease. The residents of Wrocław are cut off from the outside world, beginning an unprecedented fight for survival.

name: Право на любовь
summary:
Rich people are settling in a new, newly built cottage village. Every house is a real fortress. All the residents of the village are prosperous, successful, self—confident people. They are relaxing in the entertainment center, equipped especially for them with the latest fashion and technology. They use the services of a private airfield and a private construction company.

But financial well-being hides a monotonous life devoid of joy. Big money has made many people forget about friendship, loyalty, and love. And so destructive passions play out behind solid walls and iron doors. But among the rich, too, there are those who will fight for their happiness and the happiness of their loved ones to the very end. These people intend to firmly defend their right to love.

name: Clive Myrie's African Adventure
summary: Clive Myrie is back in another thrilling travelogue which will see him travel Africa. This series will see Clive travel to Morocco, South Africa, Nigeria and Ghana to experience the array of African culture across the continent, from food, fashion, football, art and everything in between.

name: Daughter of Fortune
summary: Shen Zhinian and her elder legitimate sister, Shen Nanqiao, are both reborn. Determined to escape the tragic fate that befell her in their previous life, Shen Nanqiao forces Zhinian into the imperial palace in her place. Thrown into the treacherous world of the harem, Shen Zhinian carefully plots every move, striking back with brilliance and strategy. Her intelligence soon captures the attention of Emperor Nangong Xuanyu. As schemes and conspiracies unfold across both the imperial court and the inner palace, the two move from mutual suspicion to genuine affection, joining hands to overcome the dangerous turmoil surrounding the throne.

name: Yes or No Games
summary: 128 contestants battle it out in 24 breathtaking worlds for €100,000. From the jungle to a pirate island to outer space, Steven Gätjen asks one question: Yes or No? Each answer determines whether the contestant wins or is eliminated. Only the one who masters all worlds wins everything.

name: Marriage Toxin
summary:
For centuries, the Poison Masters have perfected the art of assassination. Among them, the Gero family stands as one of the five most powerful families of Masters, wielding unmatched skill and influence. Hikaru Gero, heir to this infamous bloodline, has lived his life deep in the shadows of the underworld, far removed from love or marriage.

However, to ensure the Poison Master bloodline does not die out, the head of the Gero family declares that Hikaru's sister will be forced to bear an heir. Soon after, Hikaru crosses paths with Mei Kinosaki, a brilliant marriage swindler who also happens to be his current assassination target. Determined to protect his sister and solve the succession problem himself, Hikaru makes an unexpected request on the spot—asking Mei to help him get married.

"...That's the first time anyone's ever proposed like that."

And so, with the cunning marriage swindler Mei as his advisor, the elite assassin Hikaru sets out on the toughest mission for love. His goal? The ultimate marriage. The most unlikely duo—an assassin and a marriage swindler—take on the world's toughest mission for love!

name: Match Play re-edited ver.
summary: A quiet, steadfast stuntman Jaeyeon strictly follows his principles. He's assigned to train Doha, an idol cast in an action movie. But Doha is unruly, proud, and refuses to listen. Still, Jaeyeon is just as stubborn. He puts a stop to Doha's tricks and shortcuts without mercy, and the two inevitably become bitter rivals. Then one day, their usual bickering is captured in an idol behind-the-scenes video, and Jaeyeon suddenly gains unexpected popularity… marking the beginning of a situation neither of them saw coming.

name: WWE Lucha Libre AAA
summary: WWE Lucha Libre AAA highlights their partnership, blending WWE's global reach with AAA's rich Mexican tradition, focusing on shared talent like Rey Mysterio and Dominik Mysterio in explosive crossover events like Worlds Collide and TripleMania, showcasing vibrant lucha libre action for new audiences worldwide.

name: Ma voyante préférée
summary: Marilyne Delange, a medium, uses her gift to predict the future by helping her friends and neighbors.

name: Just a Dash
summary: Over-the-top and unfiltered, celebrity chef Matty Matheson whips up global comfort foods on a culinary adventure that's equal parts lessons and laughs.

name: Zaguri Imperia
summary: The series tells the story of the Zaguri family from Beersheba. The series begins with the return home of prodigal son Aviel, who was kicked out of the house by the family patriarch years earlier. His sudden return tears up the house and ignites an internal war, which further intensifies when the family starts believing they are cursed.

name: Alertes: Pelletier
summary: While on vacation at his old friend François's cottage, Sergeant Pelletier finds himself embroiled in a murder investigation led by Regional Sergeant Évelyne Dumoulin. This unexpected investigation will change Pelletier forever.

name: Million-Follower Detective
summary: A masked online fortune teller predicts the murders of social media influencers, sparking an investigation led by a veteran detective and his mentee.

name: Straight to Hell
summary:
Straight to Hell examines the untold life of one of modern Japan's most influential and controversial figures. 

Born in the aftermath of World War II, Hosoki grew up in poverty and entered the nightlife world at a young age. By her twenties, she was running a series of successful clubs in Ginza, earning the nickname "The Queen of Ginza." Drawing on the instincts she developed there, she later reinvented herself as a fortune-teller whose influence swept the nation. She rose to prominence through her self-created Six Star Astrology and became a household name through bestselling books and frequent television appearances. Revered by some and feared by others, she left behind a legacy that continues to provoke fascination and debate.

name: Funny AF with Kevin Hart
summary: The funniest comics from NYC, Chicago and LA face off for a spot at Netflix Is a Joke Festival 2026 — with the winner crowned live by your real-time vote.

name: Bait
summary: Bait is about a struggling actor, whose last chance to hit it big comes in the form of an audition of a lifetime. The series follows him over the course of four wild days as his life spirals out of control and his family, ex-lover and the entire world weigh in on whether he is the right man for the job.

name: HBCU Legacy Bowl
summary: The HBCU Legacy Bowl, is a postseason all-star game showcasing the best NFL draft-eligible football players from Historically Black Colleges and Universities. The event was announced by the Black College Football Hall of Fame on March 18, 2021.

name: Saban
summary:
Saban tells the story of Nick Saban's extraordinary career, highlighted by his 17 seasons at Alabama, where he led the team to six national titles and reestablished the Crimson Tide as the preeminent program in college football.

The series will peel back the curtain on the long closely guarded world of Saban, with hundreds of hours of never-before-seen footage from the locker room and practice fields, as well as many other behind-the-scenes moments in his career at Alabama, and prior to that LSU, the Miami Dolphins, and Michigan State among other stops. There's also a wealth of present-day interviews with Saban and his wife, the legendary Ms. Terry Saban, whose own influence and impact played a massive role in Nick's success as a coach and leader.

Saban is a portrait of the relentless drive that powered seven national titles (six at Alabama, and one at LSU), produced four Heisman trophy winners, generations of NFL stars, and set a standard of greatness in college football that may never be met again. It also explores "The Process," Saban's famed approach to coaching that transformed his teams and defined his leadership style.

name: Трёшка
summary: Voronezh, the noughties is a time when the glamour from magazines is just reaching the regions, stretch jeans are worn with sequins, "Hands Up!" sounds from every iron, salaries are no longer given out in biscuits, but life is still based on wit and family ties. 35-year—old Dasha is a divorced mother, works at a factory and secretly meets with her boss Roman. She lives in a three-bedroom apartment with her parents and 14-year-old daughter. But one day her sister Lena suddenly moves into the apartment with her husband Seryoga and two children. To defend the right to the only large room, Dasha decides to announce her relationship with Roman and force him to move in with her. Now there are nine people under one roof and every day turns into a survival comedy. At the same time, ten years later, Dasha's ex-husband Dima appears, confident that he must return his family and his former life. A real family blockbuster begins in the apartment, where the stakes are love, a roof over your head and a place on the couch.

name: Confessions of a Killer
summary: Two stolen lives and a 'suicide pact' that never was. In previously unbroadcast tapes, a killer coldly recounts how he got away with a double murder for 18 years.
